model.rationale: Core 2026.10.x REST GET takes mutation_lock and re-parses automations.yaml; cost per automation chosen so one read is ~0.30 s at N=113, as observed live (HAMCP-171).

model_validation: The base run reproduces the live build (34.8 s vs 33.7-41.5 s) and queue wait (avg 15.1 s / max 31.9 s vs 15.6 s / ~33 s).
projected_live_effect: Index build: from ~34-42 s to the inventory reads plus one pipelined WebSocket batch (226 commands, window 16) over in-memory config; modelled 0.4 s, 1.4 s with a 10x slower per-command cost. Live WebSocket per-command latency is unmeasured here (no live access); the acceptance live check records it.

REST automation_config reads per build: 113 -> 0 when every automation is loaded, non-blueprint, and has no pending write; each blueprint instance, unavailable entity, identity mismatch or pending write still costs one reported stored read.

A write issued during the post-restart prewarm: Core lock wait goes from up to 8 queued whole-file reads (2.7 s modelled) to none (300.6 ms = idle write); a write that waits for the index goes from the whole build (34.5 s modelled; 35-44 s live) to the batch build (0.3-1.3 s modelled).
